stem: Which phrase from "See It Through" illustrates that the mother also accomplishes tasks in a creative way?

options.label: F
options.text: mention that my mom is in a wheelchair

options.label: G
options.text: a cheerleader on the sideline of my soccer games

options.label: H
options.text: strapping herself to some stranger's lap in order to zip-line

options.label: J
options.text: mother showed me how to live outside of limits

visual_elements: Her coach now uses a whistle to keep her centered, and Brown uses a beeper that alerts her when to plant her pole.
